list.name: Jingle Jam 2024
list.description:
From the 1st - 14th of December, we'll be streaming all day, every day to raise as much money as we can for the 8 fantastic Jingle Jam 2024 charities. So far, Jingle Jam has raised just shy of £25 million for 37 charities and we can wait to kick off this year's festive fundraiser!

The best part is, if you donate £35 or more, you'll receive a super collection of games for your generosity! 

Join us as we kick it all off at 5pm GMT on December 1st at Twitch.tv/yogscast.
